note: ORPHAN Pro 23:18 — surely there is a future, and your hope will not be cut off.

dims.v: enduring hope — the assurance of a future that will not be cut off

the hope of the one who keeps the fear of the LORD — the assurance that there is a future and that his hope will not be cut off, an expectation grounded not in circumstance but in God's ordering of the end
the confident expectation that the God-fearer's end is secure

tiqvah (hope) — 'surely there is a future, and your HOPE will not be cut off' (23:18; cf 24:14); the fear of the LORD (23:17) grounds a hope that endures. The God-fearer's expectation of a good end is sure, where the wicked's hope perishes.
